sections.title: Sound of letter X
paragraphs: You call this letter (X) /gz/. Its main sound is heard in the word (box) /bɒks/, which means a container with flat sides. This letter makes three different sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say X
paragraphs: For the first sound, stop the air with the back of your tongue. Release it without voice, and then hiss air through your teeth. For the second sound, make that same stop and hiss, but turn your voice on. A voiced sound makes your throat shake. For the third sound, blow air through your teeth with voice.

sections.title: Spelling rules for X
paragraphs: At the end of words and before voiceless consonants, this letter makes the sound in (tax) /tæks/. Between vowels before a stressed syllable, it makes the sound in (exam) /ɪɡ.zæm/. At the start of a word, it sounds like a simple buzz in (xylophone) /zaɪ.lə.fəʊn/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with X
paragraphs: Do not drop the first stop sound when you say (exist) /ɪɡ.zɪst/. Be sure to start with your throat closed. At the start of a word, do not say two sounds. In (xenon) /zɛn.ɒn/, say only one smooth buzzing sound without any stop before it.
